hints: Look closely at the vacuole size and the protoplast in each diagram. Cell Y is swollen and round with a huge vacuole, while cell Z shows the protoplast shrinking and pulling away from a wavy wall.

Remember water always moves by osmosis from higher water potential (less negative, more dilute) to lower water potential (more negative, more concentrated). Use the direction of movement to decide if the cell started higher or lower than its solution.
walkthrough:
**Read the pictures like a story of water movement**

Look at what happened after 50 minutes. Cell Y is turgid with a very large vacuole, so water must have moved in. Cell Z is plasmolysed with the vacuole and cytoplasm pulling away from the wall, so water must have moved out. Cell X is in between.

Key idea: gain of water = turgid, loss of water = plasmolysed.

**Link water movement to water potential**

Water moves from a less negative (higher) water potential to a more negative (lower) water potential.

$$\text{water moves: higher } \Psi \rightarrow \text{ lower } \Psi$$
For Y, water entered, so the cell interior started with a lower, more negative $\Psi$ than its solution. For Z, water left, so the cell interior started with a higher, less negative $\Psi$ than its solution.

**Match cells to the sugar concentrations**

A 10% sugar solution is the most concentrated, so it has the most negative water potential and causes the most water loss. A 2.5% solution is the most dilute and causes water gain.
Therefore cell Y, which gained water, was in 2.5%, and cell Z, which lost the most water and is strongly plasmolysed, was in 10%. This makes statements 1, 2 and 3 all correct.

options.A: Correct, statements 1, 2 and 3 are all true. Y gained water so it started lower than its solution, Z lost most water so it was in 10% and started higher (less negative) than its solution.
options.B: Incorrect, it leaves out statement 3 which is true because Z lost water to the concentrated solution, so Z must have started with a less negative water potential.
options.C: Incorrect, it leaves out statement 2 which is true because Z shows the strongest plasmolysis, matching the strongest 10% sugar solution.
options.D: Incorrect, it leaves out statement 1 which is true because Y became turgid, meaning water entered from the solution to the more negative cell.
